                                          ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing all of the RT4 Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 2J in the area bounded by:

       A line 112 feet south of the south line of West Flournoy Street; the public alley next
       east of and parallel to South Central Park Avenue; a line 142 feet south of the south
       line of West Flournoy Street; South Central Park Avenue,

to those of an RS3 Single-Unit Detached House District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.



                                              Mohique USoptt
                                              Alderman, 24"^ Ward




Common Address:               713 W. Central Park (16-14-404-005)
